items.title: Mitch Johnson says Jayden Quaintance is "doing great" rehab-wise, saying he's gotten "lost in the process of it."
items.author: Tom Orsborn
items.body_excerpt:
Mitch Johnson says Jayden Quaintance is "doing great" rehab-wise, saying he's gotten "lost in the process of it."

"He's done a great job of that while also being super engaged with his teammates and his staff. I have no expectation other than him just kind of keep pounding the rock..."

items.title: Spurs are playing the second game of a b2b tonight here in Salt Lake City, but their injury report is limited to Harris (calf) and Quaintance (recovery from knee surgery).
items.author: Tom Orsborn
items.body_excerpt:
Spurs are playing the second game of a b2b tonight here in Salt Lake City, but their injury report is limited to Harris (calf) and Quaintance (recovery from knee surgery).

Season is young. And the rout of the Kings allowed them to rest key guys.

items.title: While there are no official injury reports in the preseason, #Spurs say other than Tobias Harris (calf strain), Maliq Brown (back tightness) and Jayden Quaintance (knee surgery rehab), everyone is good to go for tonight’s exhibition opener against Atlanta.
